q.vi: Lớp tiếp theo của tôi ở đâu?

faq.k: next class lop tiep theo where timetable
faq.a: Open My timetable. The next class and its room are shown on Home once you have saved classes and set the semester start date.

q.en: How do I get to D3?

faq.k: how get building d3 c1 directions navigate duong di
faq.a: Open the campus map, choose the building as destination and tap Navigate. The route is schematic, so use the Maps link for real directions.

q.en: How do I register for courses?
q.vi: Làm sao đăng ký học phần?

faq.k: register registration dang ky hoc phan course
faq.a: Plan your classes in the Course planner. Official registration is done on the HUST system during the registration window. Ask the Academic Affairs Office for dates.

q.en: Which office handles my student card?
q.vi: Phòng nào lo thẻ sinh viên?

faq.k: student card the sinh vien office phong ban
faq.a: The Office of Student Affairs (OSA) per the project brief. Open Office finder for details.

q.en: My visa is about to expire. What now?
q.vi: Thị thực sắp hết hạn, tôi làm gì?

faq.k: visa expire extension gia han thi thuc
faq.a: HUST says to submit extension documents at least 1 month before expiry (page published 2021). Contact OSA or the international office now.
Open Emergency Help for the steps and phrases.

q.en: Can this app log me in to the student portal?
q.vi: Ứng dụng này có đăng nhập cổng sinh viên được không?

faq.a: No. The app is not connected to HUST systems and never asks for your SIS password.
